raw_text: ALERT: Unauthorized access detected in Mumbai Port Trust vessel traffic management system and cargo scheduling database. Zero-day vulnerability exploited in legacy SCADA interface. Maritime traffic being rerouted to JNPT. NCIIPC issuing critical alert to all major Indian ports. Incident response teams isolating affected systems.
clean_text: Unauthorized access at Mumbai Port Trust vessel traffic and cargo systems. Zero-day in legacy SCADA exploited. Maritime traffic rerouted to JNPT. NCIIPC alerting all ports.
